name: Comp Check
office_task: For each appraisal, check the price against comparable sales chosen by written rules, each sourced and dated, and hold the one-page evidence for the agent to approve.
systems_of_record: the agency's listing system, which issues the listing_id for the appraisal and holds the subject property and the agent's appraisal
the recorded sales source the agency already licenses (for example a state valuer-general sales record)
the document store the approved one-pager and its record of what was shown are published into, which issues the report_id

emits.write: the exact one-pager version the agent approved, released to the vendor on the listing, with an append-only record of what was shown: the rules, every comparable with its source, sale date and read date, the range, the agent's estimate apart, who approved it, who it went to and the date
emits.readback: reading the listing's records back by listing_id and date returns each report_id with its version, released_on and approved_by, matching the approved version comparable for comparable; no id back means nothing was released and an exception is raised

emits.write: an exception on the listing naming the agent: a quoted figure below the evidence (held, with the sales above it), sales still stale after a re-read (held), too few comparables for a range, or a version the agent has not approved
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the listing_id, the version, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
